title: Coptic→Greek lexical candidates (observed wordforms / inferred lemmas / confidence)

observed_wordform.description: Attested Coptic↔Greek surface forms from train symmetrized alignments. Counts are evidence-backed.

inferred_lemma.description: Derived lemma proxies from observed wordforms. Method labels are mandatory; not MorphGNT/SCRIPTORIUM lemmas.

inference_method.disclaimer: Inferred proxies only — not attested morphological lemmas; do not collapse with observed_wordform layer.

confidence_estimate.description: Separate heuristic ranking vs calibrated confidence keyed to observed wordform pairs. confidence is null without an independent calibration rule; heuristic_ranking_score ranks only.

inference_method.disclaimer: Inferred proxies only — not attested morphological lemmas; do not collapse with observed_wordform layer.

confidence_estimates.notes: observed_index references observed_wordforms.rows; components rebuilt on load from observed evidence; heuristic_ranking_score is uncalibrated; confidence null means no calibrated correctness claim.

provenance.protocol: Train-only symmetrized links from phase2_active_aligners; holdout/dev/omission/Thomas-7 excluded from observations.
